_comment:
Cortex 13-agent GitHub Issue Pipeline expressed as a DAP bundle.

ARCHITECTURE
  Phase 1 (enrichment): mockup → specify → cicd → dispatcher → finalize
  [human gate]
  Phase 2 (execution):  coder → designer → documenter
  [human gate]
  Phase 3 (merge):      code_reviewer → tester → pr_creator → reviewer
  [human gate]
  pr_merger

STATE CONTRACT
  Cortex-specific fields (issue_url, repo, issue_number, run_id, …)
  live in PipelineState.extensions so the generic schema is not polluted.
  Each node reads extensions via the cortex.state_adapter module.

DEPENDENCIES
  cortex-project package must be installed in the DAP engine venv:
    pip install -e /path/to/cortex-project  (or uv add via path dep)
  Environment variables required (same as standalone cortex run):
    CORTEX_GH_TOKEN_READ, CORTEX_GH_TOKEN_ISSUES, CORTEX_GH_TOKEN_CODE,
    CORTEX_GH_TOKEN_MERGE, CORTEX_DATABASE_URL

pipeline.name: Cortex GitHub Issue Pipeline
pipeline.description: 13-agent pipeline: GitHub issue → Phase 1 enrichment → Phase 2 coding → Phase 3 PR merge. Port of the standalone Cortex pipeline to a DAP bundle.

cx_mockup.name: Cortex Mockup
cx_mockup.description: Phase 1 — structures a raw GitHub issue into the standard 5-section template.

cx_specify.name: Cortex Specify
cx_specify.description: Phase 1 — fills Technical Specification (target files, deps, arch impact, commands).

cx_cicd.name: Cortex CI/CD
cx_cicd.description: Phase 1 — fills Test Criteria (RED/GREEN/REFACTOR test cases).

cx_dispatcher.name: Cortex Dispatcher
cx_dispatcher.description: Phase 1 — generates Task Assignment: routes work to coder/designer/documenter with budgets.

cx_finalize.name: Cortex Finalize
cx_finalize.description: Phase 1 — reviews all enrichment sections, sets issue_ready=True/False.

cx_human_gate.name: Human Approval Gate
cx_human_gate.description: Pauses the pipeline and waits for operator approval (POST /runs/{id}/resume) before continuing.
cx_human_gate._note: timeout_ms = 24h. Operator calls POST /runs/{id}/resume to continue.

cx_coder.name: Cortex Coder
cx_coder.description: Phase 2 — executes coding tasks via Claude Code CLI. Creates branch, implements, commits, pushes.
cx_coder._note: timeout_ms = 30 min. Claude Code may run long multi-turn sessions.

cx_designer.name: Cortex Designer
cx_designer.description: Phase 2 — CSS/UI changes assigned by dispatcher. Skips if no designer tasks.

cx_documenter.name: Cortex Documenter
cx_documenter.description: Phase 2 — documentation-only changes. Skips if no documenter tasks.

cx_code_reviewer.name: Cortex Code Reviewer
cx_code_reviewer.description: Phase 3 — diffs branch against main; approves or routes back to coder retry loop.

cx_tester.name: Cortex Tester
cx_tester.description: Phase 3 — runs the project test suite against the coder branch. Routes to retry_prepare on failure.

cx_pr_creator.name: Cortex PR Creator
cx_pr_creator.description: Phase 3 — creates the GitHub PR from the coder branch to main.

cx_reviewer.name: Cortex Reviewer
cx_reviewer.description: Phase 3 — final code review of the PR. Produces DECISION: APPROVE or REJECT verdict.

cx_pr_merger.name: Cortex PR Merger
cx_pr_merger.description: Phase 3 — merges the PR using rlagowski token (GH_TOKEN_MERGE). Different GitHub user enforces code/merge separation.

install_instructions.summary: Install cortex-project package in DAP engine venv, set env vars, import bundle.
steps: 2. Set env vars in dap-engine .env.local — see LAGOVALUT/dap/!env.md for token list
3. Start dap-engine with DAP_DATABASE_URL pointing at the dap PostgreSQL database
4. Import bundle: POST /pipelines/import with this JSON as body
5. Create a run: POST /projects/{cortex_project_id}/run/github-issue with {"issue_url": "https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/N"} in extensions
6. Approve gates: POST /runs/{id}/resume after each phase completes
known_gaps: State adapter: Cortex nodes read state['repo'], state['issue_number'] etc. directly. When running inside DAP, these must come from state['extensions']. cortex.state_adapter (Cortex #225) handles this — verify it's wired.
coder/designer/documenter use Claude Code CLI subprocess — DAP_WORKING_DIR must point to the project workspace clone.
